annotations.annotation_text: Structural opening of Book 1, Chapter 6, page 164. Continues the multi-layered dream narrative depicting the nocturnal transmigration of human history and Dublin topography.
sources: Campbell, Joseph and Robinson, Henry Morton. A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/skeletonkeytofin00camp

annotations.annotation_text: Mid-page polysemic discourse on page 164: Joyce weaves multilingual puns, etymological roots, and rhythmic cadences capturing the shifting consciousness of the collective unconscious.
sources: Tindall, William York. A Reader's Guide to Finnegans Wake. https://archive.org/details/readersguidetofi00tind
Atherton, James S. The Books at the Wake. https://archive.org/details/booksatwake0000athe

annotations.annotation_text: Viconian philosophical framework: Giambattista Vico's cyclical schema of history (divine theocratic age, heroic aristocratic age, human democratic age, and ricorso), invoked through "human".
sources: Vico, Giambattista. Scienza Nuova (The New Science, 1725). https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
Beckett, Samuel, et al. Our Exagmination Round His Factification... https://archive.org/details/ourexagminationr0000unse
Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Giambattista Vico. https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/vico/
